requirements.statement: A build uses one effective configuration bundle and rejects stale or contradictory configuration.
requirements.acceptance: Reconfigure different targets and inject invalid symbols; no prior generated bundle or cache may be accepted after failure.

requirements.statement: Nested critical sections, bounded waits and object destruction obey an explicit cross-backend contract.
requirements.acceptance: Host concurrency, FreeRTOS contract models and actual IRQ priority/tick wrap experiments agree; no deadlocks or expired-handle access.

requirements.statement: After SPI timeout or cancellation the DMA engine cannot access a released caller buffer.
requirements.acceptance: Error/completion/cancel races settle exactly once; actual DMA abort/readback and buffer canaries pass on a named board revision.

requirements.statement: Every interrupted persistence or key migration recovers a complete old or new record.
requirements.acceptance: Exhaustive flash-model operation failures and physical interrupted program/erase tests retain recoverable authenticated state.

requirements.statement: Industrial communication and management workloads keep the control path within its reviewed deadline and resource budgets.
requirements.acceptance: The actual product defines period, deadline, jitter, stack/heap and queue limits; worst-load board measurements meet them.

requirements.statement: Authentication, entropy and update failure never become a successful insecure state.
requirements.acceptance: Maintained-crypto tamper/nonce/key tests and actual boot recovery, rollback and power interruption evidence pass for the configured image layout.

requirements.statement: Physical verification and signed evidence refer to the same board, image, source and effective configuration.
requirements.acceptance: Lease collision, wrong board, wrong readback, fake HIL and changed artifacts are rejected; physical transcripts and signatures bind the release evidence set.

requirements.statement: Every provisioned device has a unique public identity and a retrievable image/calibration/audit relationship.
requirements.acceptance: A real station verifies signed release, flash readback, calibration and attestation; duplicate UID/identity and credential-shaped audit outputs fail.
